_doc: Live /anonymize red-team cases. Person refs (clientes:<id>, empleados:<id>, users:<id>) are resolved against the raw run at test time, so no original values live in the repo. Placeholders: {name} {NAME_UPPER} {name_cyr} {name_nl} {name_slug} {first} {email} {email_spoken} {cedula} {phone_spaced} {handle} {raw_text}. `absent` lists placeholder keys or `lit:<string>`; `pseudonym` is same (must equal GET /entities), new (unseen pseudonym), distinct_new (each new person gets its own) or null.
